description: This file contains utility functions for safely reading and writing configuration files, including backup management and file selection logic, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: safeFileSave
methods.description: Safely saves a file by renaming a temporary file to the desired filename and creating a backup if the original exists.

methods.name: chooseFileToRead
methods.description: Determines if the original file or its backup can be read, or if a new file should be created.
